description: DayOneLead gives B2B teams one ChatGPT workflow to browse and filter over one million newly registered business leads, qualify prospects, manage CRM records, and plan and manage email campaigns from first draft through replies. It searches the customer's DayOneLead account and reveals contact details only when requested, subject to the account's daily reveal limit. Campaign launches, outbound replies, and campaign endings always return a preview and require explicit confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Browse newly registered businesses and find the best matches for my ideal customer.
Plan and manage an email campaign for my business, starting with a preview.
Show my campaign performance and unread replies, then help me draft responses.
